updates.title: The ship's cat
updates.text: There's a cat living on the footer of every page. Tap it to see how it's doing and give it a treat. The whole crew feeds it: signing the log, arcade runs, Ko-fi tips and more all count.

updates.title: Secret hints
updates.text: Stuck hunting secrets? There's now a page of clues for all 13, with bigger hints if you need them.

updates.title: Ask the Captain
updates.text: Send in a question and read the answers.

updates.title: Ship map
updates.text: Every room on the ship is a page on the site. There might be one that isn't on the plan...

updates.title: Clip of the Month
updates.text: Vote for your favorite home page clip. The winner gets a badge.

updates.title: More poster styles
updates.text: The poster maker now does Most Wanted, Missing and Crew ID too.
